### What changed

- **Save and switch workspace layouts.** Keep feature combinations, splits, tab order and proportions as presets. The desktop window’s ellipsis menu brings presets and Always on top together; manage saved layouts under Layout & position. Switching preserves drafts and reading positions.
- **Use quick phrases independently.** Manage reusable prompts in their own panel and settings page, with separate fill/send behavior. Full content appears by default, long instructions expand on demand, and short names are optional. Existing phrases and drafts are preserved.
- **Choose from the full Codex model catalog.** Model service settings share the available model list with quick switching, even when quick switching is disabled. Reading the list does not change the current chat model. Saved presets now show their reasoning level alongside the name and Fast indicator.
- **Native macOS window controls.** Desktop windows reuse the existing Palboo App, Dock position and icon, with native traffic lights and standard arrow cursors. Fix flickering controls and content, and unintended text selection during resizing.
- **More reliable startup and mode switching.** Improve recovery between release and development modes and retry temporary macOS launch failures while preserving the original data directories.
- **Clearer compact views and settings.** Keep model usage and actions visible in small panels, use actual feature components in settings previews, and group Bot actions in the existing header. Settings header icons are grouped together and the search shortcut is removed.

### 更新内容

- **保存并切换主界面布局。** 将功能组合、分栏、标签顺序与比例保存为预设。桌面窗口右上角三点菜单集中提供布局预设与置顶，在「布局与位置」管理已存布局；切换保留草稿和阅读位置。
- **常用语独立使用。** 通过独立面板和设置页管理常用指令，单独选择填入或发送方式。默认显示正文，长指令可展开，短名称选填；原预设和已有草稿保留。
- **模型配置显示完整 Codex 目录。** 模型服务与快切共用可选模型列表，快切关闭后仍可读取，读取不会切换当前聊天模型。模型预设直接显示已保存的思考等级，便于配合名称和 Fast 标记区分配置。
- **原生 macOS 窗口操作。** 桌面窗口沿用 Palboo 的 App、Dock 位置与图标，使用原生红黄绿和系统箭头。修复缩放时按钮、正文闪烁及误选文字的问题。
- **启动与模式切换更可靠。** 改进正式／开发模式的交接恢复，并对 macOS 暂时性启动失败进行重试，保留原数据目录。
- **紧凑界面和设置更清晰。** 小面板中的模型额度与操作保持可见，设置预览复用真实功能组件，Bot 操作集中在原标题行。设置页图标统一排列，移除搜索快捷键。
